name: Fairmont Singapore
positioning: City-center Fairmont hotel near Marina Bay and the Civic District, with 12 restaurants and bars
best_for: Travelers who want a city-center base near Marina Bay and the Civic District
Food and drink lovers who like having many restaurants and bars under one roof

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of the city, near Marina Bay and the Civic District.
Singapore Changi Airport is a 20-minute drive away, reached by airport shuttle or the hotel's limousine service.
Rooms offer city and skyline views.
The hotel has 12 restaurants and bars.
The hotel is in the same Marina Bay building as the Swissôtel The Stamford.
The hotel serves afternoon teas with changing themes.
Bathroom amenities are by Le Labo.
JAAN By Kirk Westaway is helmed by British chef Kirk Westaway.

highlights.text: The hotel has the world's first hotel-based urban aquaponics farm.
Guests are greeted by Pakcik Ismail, a top hat-wearing doorman.
ANTI:DOTE is an Art Deco-inspired bar with a marble bar and red velvet.
The hotel is near the Singapore Art Museum and Gardens By The Bay, plus the central business district and shopping.

considerations.text: This is a city-center hotel, and Changi Airport is a 20-minute drive away.
The hotel shares a Marina Bay building with the Swissôtel The Stamford.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Singapore review
